description: This deposit provides a Shapefile road-network archive attributed to AMAP, with a README describing China coverage from 2000 to 2019. The public Zenodo download is free and includes supporting DBF components in a 7z container. Documentation states WGS84 coordinates and proposes path planning and GIS analysis. It can supply road geometry for transport-network simulation, subject to checking actual topology and time slices. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this extract. The named creator is AMAP in deposited metadata, but official provider endorsement was not independently established. Licensing is contradictory: Zenodo says CC BY 4.0, the included file is an MIT template with unfilled copyright fields, and the README prohibits commercial use. These terms require clarification before redistribution. Exact road classes, attribute definitions, annual completeness and positional uncertainty remain unknown. The archive was not downloaded or converted into a routing model.
